description: Return the open meeting slots a Lucie Sync host offers, plus their booking rules (durations offered, minimum notice, how far ahead you can book, buffer between meetings). Returns only bookable slots and policy — never the host's raw calendar. Use this to find a time before proposing one to the user. Slots are absolute instants (ISO-8601 UTC). Pass the booker's viewerTimeZone so times display in THEIR local zone — the booker should never have to do time-zone math.

durationMinutes.description: Desired meeting length in minutes. Must be one the host offers. Defaults to 30 if omitted.

from.description: ISO-8601 start of the search window. Defaults to now + the host's minimum notice.

handle.description: The host's booking handle, e.g. "@alice" or "alice" (from their lucie.network/book/@<handle> link). The leading @ is optional.

to.description: ISO-8601 end of the search window. Defaults to the host's max-advance horizon.

viewerTimeZone.description: The booker's IANA time zone, e.g. "Asia/Singapore" or "America/New_York". Pass the booker's own zone so slots are shown in their local time. Defaults to the host's zone if omitted.

name: check_availability
title: Check a Lucie host's open booking slots
